items.text: ETR W2 injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Brown=Doubs/Douglas; plus streamers Wentz/Shough/Vele/Deebo.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping with FAAB/drop/stream guidance.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for immediate role expansion.
items.opportunity: Teammate absences create clear snap/target paths

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach. Same knee as prior PCL sprain/bone bruise last year; scary but day-to-day.
items.why: Coach Kubiak: working tail off, day-to-day after meniscus trim; will play if ready.
items.implication: Monitor practice; if active huge upgrade, else Mayer continues TE1.

items.text: Patriots placed A.J. Brown on IR with high-ankle sprain; out at least 4 games (earliest W6), possibly 4-6 weeks, no surgery.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; IR move locks minimum 4-game absence.
items.implication: Doubs/Hollins/Douglas elevate for Maye targets; Brown stash only.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury; status up in air vs Raiders. Monitored throughout week, day-to-day per Harbaugh.
items.why: Left W1 early with rib/chest; imaging and week monitoring.
items.implication: If out, Tre Harris primary beneficiary for targets/routes.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid 49ers WR injuries (Stribling out longer).
items.why: Role expansion with other WRs dinged; Shanahan schemes opportunities.
items.implication: Must-add in most leagues for WR2/3 upside.

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad.
items.why: Knee injury from W1; IR designation confirms multi-week absence.
items.implication: Judkins primary but saw only 13 routes even with Sampson out early; Sanders also got 13. Committee risk.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated early-down and receiving opportunities immediately in new offense.
items.implication: Lock-in every-week RB1 with elite volume floor and ceiling.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early RB opps + high route/target share

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion; strong love and Monday Night Miracle performer.
items.why: Dominant MNF usage and production in new KC role.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied for No.1 RB Utilization Score (99) in W1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23-6 for 156 scrimmage + 2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1.
items.why: Every-down role with elite efficiency behind improved OL; historical comps strong.
items.implication: Treat as locked RB1 ROS; buy if available.

items.text: Travis Etienne only 43% rush attempts and 38% routes despite 58% snaps with Kamara out; committee with Miller. Downgrades to low-end RB2 pending Kamara return.
items.why: Shared backfield even without Kamara; low route share limits PPR.
items.implication: Flex only; Kamara return further dilutes. Miller stash/handcuff.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious; day-to-day, would have played if playoff game. MRI but expected minimal miss. Ja'Kobi Lane wrist longer-term.
items.why: Left early but sources/coach confirm not serious; Lane fractured wrist multi-game.
items.implication: Flowers likely plays; Bateman/others benefit from Lane absence.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9; MNF was 2.5. Just 2 targets (7% share) but ran 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd behind Worthy). Needs volume to produce given short aDOT.
items.why: Routes present but targets and depth of target extremely low in debut.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR3/flex; monitor target share expansion.
items.opportunity: High route participation (29/33) but low target share

items.text: Bucky Irving 62% snaps, 58% routes, 53% rushes, stayed on LDD/short-yardage vs Gainwell concerns. 85 Util Score, upgrades to mid RB2.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in all situations despite preseason reports.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks in W1 even after Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Limited receiving role despite backfield injury; committee.
items.implication: RB3/flex with rush upside but capped PPR; Sampson IR helps little.
